title: Digital Edition of the Ethica Complementoria
notes: Annika Rockenberger's GitHub project (repo live 200) holds the TEI P5 transcriptions and analysis code for her digital scholarly edition of the 17th-c. German etiquette prints of the Ethica Complementoria tradition, published with the Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel; the harvest covers A3 (1648), C3 (1665), Complementierbüchlein (B6, 1660), Cochleatio Novissima (1656), Klag und Trost (1652) — matching origin 'Ethica Complementoria project: Ethica Complementoria (A3) (1648)'. A companion repo greflinger-dse/EthicaComplementoria holds edition files linked to DTA publications; data on GitHub under CC-BY. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: Annika Rockenberger (herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbuettel / University of Oslo)
license_note: Includes CC-BY-4.0. Licences or rights differ by text, corpus or editorial layer; consult the source terms for the selected material.
